messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty: `PD-Alert` fired for host gpu-rt-23 (kubelet NotReady). Autopage threshold met. paging eng-oncall rotation.

ryan: acked. pulling logs. seeing repeated kernel oops in dmesg during last 3min.

sarah: I'm on it, attaching serial console now. can someone check if there's an ongoing maintenance window? @lisa?

lisa: no maintenance scheduled. saw a similar pattern last week on rt-19 (nvme timeout -> kubelet stuck).

mike: kubectl output below:
```
$ kubectl get nodes gpu-rt-23 -o wide
NAME        STATUS     ROLES    AGE   VERSION
gpu-rt-23   NotReady   gpu      125d v1.27.3
```

mike: kubelet logs (tail):
```
May 14 12:44:10 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3a:00): 79, pid 2145
May 14 12:44:11 kubelet: Node status not updated: failed to get status: error reading node info
```

ryan: serial console shows machine hit kernel panic then soft lockup. trying to ping IP 10.2.44.23 -> no response.

incidentbot: Incidentbot note: escalation to SEV-2 if >2 racks impacted or customer impact confirmed.

sarah: initial impact check: 2 pods on Dedicated pool were on that node. both rescheduled, but 1 job (long-running batching) failed to restart due to affinity. potential customer-facing slowness for one tenant. tagging support.

lisa: I'll open RMA ticket for the host (HARDWARE suspicion). can we cordon and drain as immediate mitigation?

mike: cordon in progress: `kubectl cordon gpu-rt-23` -> node marked unschedulable. starting drain with --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data.

ryan: drain completed for user pods, system pods on OOM or kube-proxy remained on node (kmod stuck). confirm node still unreachable from k8s controlplane.

incidentbot: PagerDuty: escalation sent to oncall+infra. next escalation in 12m if no ack from infra.

sarah: customer-impact update: one Dedicated customer (cust-id: C-9871) reported a spike in error budget usage due to job restarts. severity low->medium, not site-wide. notifying CS.

lisa: created ticket INC-7310 and RMA-OPEN-452, attached dmesg and serial dump. requesting oncall-infra to validate power-cycle. @ryan can you attempt remote IPMI reboot?

ryan: attempting BMC powercycle now:
```
ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.2.44.250 -U admin -P **** chassis power cycle
Sending command to 10.2.44.250... Success
```

mike: host came back to network, kubelet started but shows crashlooping due to nvidia driver oops. logs: `nvidia: GPU reset failed`

sarah: temporary mitigation: taint node `redwood/needs-driver-fix=true:NoSchedule` so schedulers avoid it until fully healthy.

incidentbot: PagerDuty: ack window cleared by ryan. escalation suppressed.

lisa: handing off to night oncall in 20m. playbook steps added to INC-7310 (collect NVMe SMART, full serial dump, hold host out of rotation until kernel patch + driver update confirmed).

mike: follow-up action: schedule patch job for kernel+driver tests on staging replica before reintroducing. assign to lisa.

ryan: leaving a quick note for whoever picks this up: if you see Xid 79 in dmesg, do not reenable batching jobs until driver backports applied.

sarah: thanks team. tagging support and CS for postmortem note. I'll create a short postmortem draft after we verify RMA results. :thumbsup:

lisa: ack and taking handoff at 00:20 UTC.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: incident resolved in PD with note: "Host recovered after BMC cycle, awaiting driver/kernel remediation and RMA follow-up".

incidentbot: Thread closed on autopage timeout window.
